title: action.plan.signed
description: PAYLOAD of the `action.plan.signed` envelope. Topic: activation.action_plan.signed. Emitted by the Ledger (§7.4) when a proposed ActionPlan is SIGNED (by a human approver, an autopilot policy within its level §17.1, or a firewall step-up for money/destructive actions). THIS is the authorization gate: connectors verify status=signed + a valid signature before ANY mutation (P4 — the structural money-safety rule). Caused by an approval.granted (human) or an autopilot policy decision. The Action Executor (§10.2) consumes ONLY signed plans.

action_plan_id.description: The ActionPlan now signed (the action.plan.created id).

signatures.description: One or more signatures authorizing execution (§7.4 signatures[]). For money/destructive actions a firewall step-up signature (HS256, sub-bound, scope spend|bulk|destructive) is required (reuse of live firewall.py model).

signer_kind.description: human = approver via inbox/WA; autopilot = policy at the granted autopilot level (§17.1); firewall_stepup = PIN/OTP step-up token for sensitive money actions (§17.3).

signer_id.description: user id / policy id / step-up token sub.

signature.description: Detached signature / step-up token / policy attestation hash.

scope.description: Step-up scope when signer_kind=firewall_stepup (reuse live vocab).

autopilot_level.description: The autopilot level that authorized an autopilot signature (L0-L4, §17.1).

approval_ref.description: The approval.granted / approval-inbox decision that produced a human signature (§17.2), if any.

prev_hash.description: Hash-chain link to the previous Ledger entry (§5.5).

hash.description: Hash of this signed Ledger entry.
